bio.en: Yuan-Hao Lin is an architecture researcher and designer focusing on resilient urban infrastructures, material re-use, and spatial phenomenology in subtropical climates.
bio.zh: 林元浩（Yuan-Hao Lin）是一位建築研究者與設計師，專注於亞熱帶氣候下的韌性城市基礎設施、材料循環再利用與空間現象學。

bioSub.en: Having completed M.Arch studies with distinction, his work investigates the intersection between precise structural engineering and soft environmental boundaries. Prior to graduate research, he worked with award-winning practices on public cultural centers and experimental housing prototypes.
bioSub.zh: 以優異成績取得建築碩士學位，其作品探討精確結構工程與柔性環境邊界之間的交會。曾於多家獲獎事務所參與公共文化中心與實驗住宅原型開發。
